intro: Create a dining space that feels open and modern with Silica. Its clear glass top, sleek slanted legs, and stable steel frame make everyday meals and celebrations stylish, spacious, and memorable.

features.title: Transparent glass top for open feel
features.text: An 8 mm toughened glass surface makes your dining room appear larger, lighter, and more welcoming for family and guests.

features.title: Strong build with unique detailing
features.text: A stainless-steel disc with a sunray finish connects the top to the understructure, ensuring stability with a refined touch.

features.title: Tetrahedral structure for support
features.text: The slanted metal legs and tensile segments create a tetrahedral frame, adding strength while giving the table a striking look.

features.title: Comfortably seats six diners
features.text: Spacious rectangular design gives everyone room to dine with ease, perfect for daily family meals or hosting friends.

features.title: Modern style for any décor
features.text: The minimalist glass top and sleek black matte understructure pair effortlessly with a variety of dining chairs and interiors.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Silica 6-Seater Toughened Glass Rectangular Dining Table
